name: Two-leg correlated parlay
signal: spread + total on the same game, priced with the measured rho
universe: games with a measured rho and a captured price
settlement_rule: both legs settled from the same official final; the parlay is graded once, and a void leg voids the parlay
note: frozen before the first bet; a change to any field above is a NEW strategy with a new id, never an edit to this file
